current.text: He is the Kings' backup point guard. The projected starters are Acuff, LaVine, Hunter, Murray and Sabonis, and the roster has no third point guard.
Trade rumors about him continue. He has 2 years left on his contract, including a player option.
He is not expected to get back to a 29-minute role.
The coach and front office seem to dislike him. Experts do not trust the Kings' rotation with him and see little fantasy value for him in Sacramento.

durable.text: He does not play defense and cannot hold up on defense in heavy minutes. This limits how much his coaches play him.

tags.name: trade risk
tags.detail: Trade rumors continue. 2 years left on his contract, including a player option.

note: Both sites give him 0 USD in value, and his ranks (Yahoo 213, ESPN 159) are outside our 144 drafted players. We paid only 2 USD for him last season, so let him go undrafted. The projections disagree on his minutes: ESPN has 26.2 minutes and 14.9 points, Yahoo only 11.5 points. Early in the season, check whether he gets steady backup point guard minutes or gets traded. A trade or an injury to Acuff or LaVine could make him a useful waiver add for threes, FT% and assists.
